---
name: Report a bug / 问题反馈
about: Report import errors, incorrect values, or display problems / 导入、数值或界面问题
title: "[Bug] "
---

## Environment / 环境

Include the app, LMU, and Windows versions.

填写软件、LMU 和 Windows 版本。

## Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤

List the actions that trigger the issue.

列出触发问题的操作步骤。

## Expected and actual behavior / 预期与实际结果

Describe what you expected and what happened. For telemetry issues, include the channel, unit, lap number, or time range if available.

说明预期与实际结果。遥测问题可注明受影响的通道、单位、圈次或时间范围。

## Evidence / 证据

Share screenshots or log excerpts with personal information removed. Share telemetry samples only if you have permission.

提供去除个人信息后的截图或日志片段。遥测样本请先确认共享授权。
